severity.description: Harm severity on an ordered scale from no-harm to imminent-danger

requires_human_review.description: Whether a human moderator must review before action is finalized

secondary_violation.description: Secondary policy domain if multiple apply

remove_content.description: Whether the content item should be immediately removed from the platform

restrict_account.description: Whether the author account should be temporarily restricted from posting

suspend_account.description: Whether the author account should be suspended for a fixed period

ban_account.description: Whether the author account should be permanently banned

escalate_to_law_enforcement.description: Whether the case must be referred to law enforcement under legal process

imminent_danger_flag.description: Whether content indicates a credible imminent physical threat requiring emergency response

targeted_individual.description: Whether the content targets a specific identifiable private individual

coordinated_activity.description: Whether the content is part of an organized coordinated campaign rather than a lone actor

dehumanizing_language.description: Whether content uses language that denies the humanity of a protected group

action_priority.description: Queue priority for the enforcement action on an ordered scale from immediate to batch

appeal_eligible.description: Whether the author is eligible to appeal the enforcement decision

notify_author.description: Whether the platform must send a notification to the author explaining the action

warn_author.description: Whether a formal warning strike should be recorded on the author profile

strike_count_tier.description: Cumulative violation strike tier on an ordered scale from clean to habitual offender

repeat_offender.description: Whether the author has a prior history of similar violations within the lookback window
